mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, category_id, priority, status, close_reason, close_stage, expect_date, planned_start, planned_end, revision, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at

d.id, d.workspace_id, d.req_id, d.title, d.description, d.source, d.item_kind, d.category_id, d.priority, d.status, d.close_reason, d.close_stage, d.expect_date, d.planned_start, d.planned_end, d.revision, d.accept_text, d.version_id, v.name AS versionName, v.status AS versionStatus, d.review_note, d.wsjf_business, d.wsjf_urgency, d.wsjf_risk, d.wsjf_effort, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.updated_at

COALESCE(ev_task.taskCount, 0) AS taskCount, COALESCE(ev_task.taskDone, 0) AS taskDone, COALESCE(ev_case.caseCount, 0) AS caseCount, COALESCE(ev_case.casePassed, 0) AS casePassed, ev_start.devStart AS devStart, ev_release.deliveredAt AS deliveredAt, CASE WHEN d.status = 'plan' AND v.status = 'released' AND ev_release.deliveredAt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS deliveryEvidenceMissing, AS deliveryStage

CASE WHEN d.status <> 'plan' THEN NULL WHEN ev_release.deliveredAt IS NOT NULL THEN 'delivered' WHEN COALESCE(ev_task.taskCount, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ev_task.taskDone, 0) >= ev_task.taskCount AND COALESCE(ev_case.caseCount, 0) = COALESCE(ev_case.casePassed, 0) THEN 'donePending' WHEN ev_start.devStart IS NOT NULL THEN 'active' ELSE 'waiting' END

d.status = 'plan' AND ev_release.deliveredAt IS NULL AND ( COALESCE(ev_task.taskCount, 0) = 0 OR COALESCE(ev_case.casePassed, 0) < COALESCE(ev_case.caseCount, 0) OR (d.expect_date IS NOT NULL AND d.expect_date < CURRENT_DATE) OR (ev_release.deliveredAt IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_version pv_evidence WHERE pv_evidence.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pv_evidence.id = d.version_id AND pv_evidence.status = 'released')) OR (d.version_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(ev_task.taskCount, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ev_task.taskDone, 0) >= ev_task.taskCount AND COALESCE(ev_case.caseCount, 0) = COALESCE(ev_case.casePassed, 0)) )

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.demand_id, COUNT(*) AS taskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taskDone FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.demand_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.demand_id ) ev_task ON ev_task.demand_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.demandId, MIN(u.started) AS devStart FROM ( SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(l.created_at) AS started FROM task t INNER JOIN task_log l ON l.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l.task_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.action = 'move' AND l.to_column IS NOT NULL AND l.to_column <> 'backlog' AND (l.from_column IS NULL OR l.from_column <> l.to_column) UNION ALL SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(tl.started_at) AS started FROM task t INNER JOIN time_log tl ON tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(t.created_at) AS started FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE((SELECT l2.from_column FROM task_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l2.task_id = t.id AND l2.action = 'move' AND l2.from_column IS NOT NULL AND l2.to_column IS NOT NULL AND l2.from_column <> l2.to_column ORDER BY l2.created_at, l2.id LIMIT 1), t.board_column) <> 'backlog' ) u WHERE u.demandId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.demandId ) ev_start ON ev_start.demandId = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.demand_id, COUNT(*) AS caseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN x.lastStatus = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS casePassed FROM ( SELECT tc.demand_id, tc.id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.status ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC), ',', 1) AS lastStatus FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN test_case_run r ON r.case_id = tc.id AND r.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND tc.demand_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tc.demand_id, tc.id ) x GROUP BY x.demand_id ) ev_case ON ev_case.demand_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.demand_id, MAX(COALESCE(vr.published_on, DATE(vr.occurred_at))) AS deliveredAt FROM version_release_item i INNER JOIN version_release vr ON vr.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND vr.id = i.release_id WHERE i.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND i.disposition = 'published' GROUP BY i.demand_id ) ev_release ON ev_release.demand_id = d.id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM demand d LEFT JOIN project_version v ON v.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND v.id = d.version_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: ORDER BY FIELD(d.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), d.created_at DESC, d.id
ORDER BY d.expect_date IS NULL, d.expect_date, d.created_at DESC, d.id
ORDER BY (d.wsjf_business + d.wsjf_urgency + d.wsjf_risk) * 10 / d.wsjf_effort IS NULL, (d.wsjf_business + d.wsjf_urgency + d.wsjf_risk) * 10 / d.wsjf_effort DESC, d.id
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY FIELD(d.status, 'review', 'pass', 'plan', 'closed', 'rej', 'canceled'), FIELD(d.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), d.created_at DESC, d.id

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d

SELECT d.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d
GROUP BY d.status

SELECT AS stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d
GROUP BY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ev_task.taskCount, 0)), 0) AS taskCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ev_task.taskDone, 0)), 0) AS taskDone, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ev_case.caseCount, 0)), 0) AS caseCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ev_case.casePassed, 0)), 0) AS casePassed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS risk, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'plan' AND ev_release.deliveredAt IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_version pv_missing WHERE pv_missing.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pv_missing.id = d.version_id AND pv_missing.status = 'released') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evidenceMissing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.priority IN ('P0', 'P1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.expect_date IS NOT NULL AND d.expect_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN d.created_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, DATE(d.created_at))) END), 0) AS longestWait, MIN(d.expect_date) AS nextExpect, MIN(CASE WHEN ev_release.deliveredAt IS NULL THEN d.expect_date END) AS nextPendingExpect, MAX(ev_release.deliveredAt) AS lastDelivered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.expect_date IS NOT NULL AND d.expect_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dueSoon, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.description IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.description) <> '' AND d.expect_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ready, AVG(CASE WHEN d.wsjf_business IS NOT NULL AND d.wsjf_urgency IS NOT NULL AND d.wsjf_risk IS NOT NULL AND d.wsjf_effort IS NOT NULL AND d.wsjf_effort > 0 THEN (d.wsjf_business + d.wsjf_urgency + d.wsjf_risk) * 10.0 / d.wsjf_effort END) AS avgWsjf, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.close_reason = 'rej' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rej, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.close_reason = 'cancel' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancel, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.close_reason = 'dup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dup, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.close_stage IN ('pass', 'plan') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS restorePass FROM demand d

SELECT COALESCE(d.version_id, '__none') AS versionId, COALESCE(v.name, '未指定版本') AS versionName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d LEFT JOIN project_version v ON v.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND v.id = d.version_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(d.version_id, '__none'), COALESCE(v.name, '未指定版本')

SELECT d.priority AS pri, d.item_kind AS kind, d.category_id AS cat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d
GROUP BY d.priority, d.item_kind, d.category_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status = #{status}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = d.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
SELECT FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId} AND status NOT IN ('closed', 'rej', 'canceled') ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'plan', 'pass', 'review'), created_at, id

SELECT FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.demand_id = #{demandId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (t.board_column = 'done'), FIELD(t.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), t.sort_order, t.created_at, t.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand (id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, category_id, priority, status, expect_date, planned_start, planned_end, revision, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{source}, #{itemKind}, #{categoryId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{expectDate}, #{plannedStart}, #{plannedEnd}, #{revision}, #{acceptText}, #{versionId}, #{reviewNote}, #{wsjfBusiness}, #{wsjfUrgency}, #{wsjfRisk}, #{wsjfEffort}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, source = #{source}, item_kind = #{itemKind}, category_id = #{categoryId}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, close_stage = #{closeStage}, expect_date = #{expectDate}, planned_start = #{plannedStart}, planned_end = #{plannedEnd}, revision = revision + 1, accept_text = #{acceptText}, version_id = #{versionId}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, wsjf_business = #{wsjfBusiness}, wsjf_urgency = #{wsjfUrgency}, wsjf_risk = #{wsjfRisk}, wsjf_effort = #{wsjfEffort}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
DELETE FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_log (workspace_id, demand_id, action, note, operator) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{action}, #{note}, #{operator})
INSERT INTO demand_log (workspace_id, demand_id, action, note, operator, change_data) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{action}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{changeData})
mapper.select: SELECT dl.id, dl.demand_id AS demandId, dl.action, dl.note, dl.operator, dl.change_data AS changeData, u.display_name AS operatorName, dl.created_at AS createdAt FROM demand_log dl LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = dl.operator WHERE dl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dl.demand_id = #{demandId} ORDER BY dl.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}

SELECT demand_id AS demandId, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'pass' THEN created_at END) AS passAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'rej' THEN created_at END) AS rejAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'plan' THEN created_at END) AS planAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'replan' THEN created_at END) AS replanAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'cancel' THEN created_at END) AS cancelAt, MAX(CASE WHEN action IN ('unpass', 'reopen') THEN created_at END) AS reviewReopenAt FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY demand_id

SELECT l.demand_id AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS docCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rd.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS docPublished, MIN(rd.created_at) AS docStart, MAX(rd.published_at) AS docEnd FROM demand_doc_link l INNER JOIN requirement_doc rd ON rd.id = l.doc_id AND rd.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.demand_id IN #{id}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = rd.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = rd.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
AND (rd.published_at IS NOT NULL OR rd.owner_user_id = #{userId})
GROUP BY l.demand_id

SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS taskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taskDone, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taskOpen, MAX(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN COALESCE(t.completed_at, DATE(t.updated_at)) END) AS devEnd, MIN(t.test_started_at) AS testStart, MAX(t.test_finished_at) AS testEnd, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column IN ('test','testing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testOpen FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY t.demand_id

SELECT u.demandId AS demandId, MIN(u.started) AS devStart FROM ( SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(l.created_at) AS started FROM task t INNER JOIN task_log l ON l.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l.task_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.action = 'move' AND l.to_column IS NOT NULL AND l.to_column <> 'backlog' AND (l.from_column IS NULL OR l.from_column <> l.to_column) AND t.demand_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(tl.started_at) AS started FROM task t INNER JOIN time_log tl ON tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.demand_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT t.demand_id AS demandId, DATE(t.created_at) AS started FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE((SELECT l2.from_column FROM task_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l2.task_id = t.id AND l2.action = 'move' AND l2.from_column IS NOT NULL AND l2.to_column IS NOT NULL AND l2.from_column <> l2.to_column ORDER BY l2.created_at, l2.id LIMIT 1), t.board_column) <> 'backlog' AND t.demand_id IN #{id} ) u GROUP BY u.demandId

SELECT x.demandId AS demandId, COUNT(*) AS caseCount, MIN(x.firstAt) AS testStart, MAX(x.lastAt) AS testEnd, SUM(CASE WHEN x.lastStatus IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caseUntested, SUM(CASE WHEN x.lastStatus IS NOT NULL AND x.lastStatus <> 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caseFailed FROM ( SELECT tc.demand_id AS demandId, tc.id AS caseId, MIN(r.created_at) AS firstAt, MAX(r.created_at) AS lastAt, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.status ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC), ',', 1) AS lastStatus FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN test_case_run r ON r.case_id = tc.id AND r.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tc.demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY tc.demand_id, tc.id ) x GROUP BY x.demandId

SELECT vr.*, FROM version_release vr INNER JOIN version_release_item i ON i.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id AND i.release_id = vr.id WHERE vr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_item d WHERE d.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id AND d.release_id = vr.id AND d.demand_id IN #{id}) ORDER BY vr.occurred_at, vr.recorded_at, vr.id, i.id

SELECT i.demand_id AS demandId, MAX(COALESCE(vr.published_on, DATE(vr.occurred_at))) AS releasedAt FROM version_release_item i INNER JOIN version_release vr ON vr.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND vr.id = i.release_id WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND i.disposition = 'published' AND i.demand_id IN #{id} GROUP BY i.demand_id
